---
title: "08 — Q5: ASVs or OTUs"
author: "Adrien Taudière"
---

Does clustering the ASVs into 97 % OTUs change the accuracy, per method and
database? Three units are scored on each ITSx region (chapter 01):

- `ASV`: the ITSx-extracted ASVs;
- `OTU`: their 97 % clusters, assigned directly ("cluster then assign");
- `OTU_derived`: the same clusters, their taxonomy resolved from the member
  ASVs by unanimity ("assign then cluster", decision 25).

Tosadori & Bosch (2026, "Decoding fungal communities: ITS extraction matters
more than ASVs vs. OTUs", *Web Ecology* 26:47–59,
<https://doi.org/10.5194/we-26-47-2026>) compared ASVs and OTUs through six
pipelines on in silico communities; this chapter repeats the comparison on
mocks with a per-sequence truth (`reviews/literature_2026-09-22.md`). Figures: Q5.1
(per-rank × method), Q5.2 (per database), Q5.3 (ASVs subsampled to the OTU
count); one tab per mock and ITSx region, default settings.

**What the comparison measures.** The scoring counts units, not reads: an OTU
is one unit however many ASVs it holds, so the OTU inputs have fewer units, the
ones carried by the non-representative ASVs are gone, and a difference in F1
mixes the assignment of each sequence with the change of unit set (`HISTORY.md`
§2 Q5, 2026-09-15). Q5.3 separates the two with ASVs subsampled to the OTU
count (chapter 01). The `OTU` truth is built on the OTU sequences, the
`OTU_derived` one on the ASVs that name the clusters, so the two can differ by
a unit.

```{r setup}
here::i_am("analysis/08_q5_units.qmd")  # _quarto.yml would otherwise make here() root = analysis/
source(here::here("analysis/00_setup.R"))
unit_order <- c("ASV", "OTU", "OTU_derived")
res_all <- cache_read("res_comp_tax")
views <- analysis_views(res_all)

# Every unit of one view (default_view() keeps a single unit), single methods,
# default settings.
unit_rows <- function(dataset_id, region_id) {
  res_all |>
    filter(dataset == dataset_id, region == region_id, !is_consensus) |>
    filter_default_settings() |>
    mutate(
      unit = factor(unit, levels = unit_order),
      tax_level = factor(tax_level, levels = tax_order)
    )
}
res_q5 <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(views)), function(i) {
  unit_rows(views$dataset[i], views$region[i]) |>
    mutate(view = views$label[i], view_id = views$id[i])
}) |>
  bind_rows() |>
  mutate(view = factor(view, levels = views$label))

# ASVs subsampled to the OTU count (chapter 01, res_subsample): F1 mean over
# the nine databases, one value per draw, and its 95 % interval over the draws.
# The observed units are averaged the same way.
subsample_schemes <- c("ASV_random", "ASV_one_per_cluster")
s08_draws <- cache_read("res_subsample") |>
  filter(!is_consensus, metrics == "F1_score", tax_level %in% c("Genus", "Gen_sp")) |>
  filter_default_settings() |>
  inner_join(select(views, dataset, region, view = label), by = c("dataset", "region")) |>
  group_by(view, tax_level, algo, unit, draw) |>
  summarise(value = mean(values), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(
    view = factor(view, levels = views$label),
    tax_level = factor(tax_level, levels = tax_order),
    unit = factor(unit, levels = subsample_schemes)
  )
s08_interval <- s08_draws |>
  group_by(view, tax_level, algo, unit) |>
  summarise(
    lo = quantile(value, 0.025),
    median = median(value),
    hi = quantile(value, 0.975),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
s08_observed <- res_q5 |>
  filter(metrics == "F1_score", tax_level %in% c("Genus", "Gen_sp")) |>
  group_by(view, tax_level, algo, unit) |>
  summarise(value = mean(values), .groups = "drop")

# One panel-tabset with a tab per view, in a chunk with results = "asis".
# As in view_tabs(), fun() must print() a figure before save_fig().
unit_tabs <- function(fun) {
  cat("\n::: {.panel-tabset}\n\n")
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(views))) {
    cat("### ", views$label[i], "\n\n", sep = "")
    fun(filter(res_q5, view_id == views$id[i]), views[i, ])
    cat("\n\n")
  }
  cat(":::\n\n")
}
```

## Summary

```{r summary-data}
#| include: false
# Computed from the same rows as the tabs below (res_q5, default settings).
s08_f1 <- res_q5 |>
  filter(metrics == "F1_score", tax_level %in% c("Genus", "Gen_sp"))
s08_by_unit <- s08_f1 |>
  group_by(view, tax_level, algo, unit) |>
  summarise(value = mean(values), .groups = "drop")
s08_unit_mean <- s08_by_unit |>
  group_by(view, tax_level, unit) |>
  summarise(value = mean(value), .groups = "drop")
s08_genus_best <- filter(s08_unit_mean, tax_level == "Genus")
s08_gensp_best <- filter(s08_unit_mean, tax_level == "Gen_sp")
# Paired per method x database column: each OTU unit minus the ASVs.
s08_paired <- s08_f1 |>
  filter(tax_level == "Genus") |>
  select(view, algo, db, unit, values) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = unit, values_from = values) |>
  mutate(otu_gain = OTU - ASV, derived_gain = OTU_derived - ASV)
s08_n_cols <- nrow(s08_paired)
s08_otu_better <- sum(s08_paired$otu_gain > 0)
s08_derived_better <- sum(s08_paired$derived_gain > 0)
# Each observed unit against the 95 % interval of the subsampled ASVs, per
# view x method (Genus F1 mean over the databases).
s08_vs_null <- s08_observed |>
  filter(tax_level == "Genus") |>
  select(view, algo, unit, value) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = unit, values_from = value) |>
  left_join(
    s08_interval |>
      filter(tax_level == "Genus") |>
      select(view, algo, unit, lo, median, hi) |>
      pivot_wider(names_from = unit, values_from = c(lo, median, hi)),
    by = c("view", "algo")
  )
s08_n_null <- nrow(s08_vs_null)
s08_asv_in_random <- with(s08_vs_null, sum(ASV >= lo_ASV_random & ASV <= hi_ASV_random))
s08_otu_above_random <- with(s08_vs_null, sum(OTU > hi_ASV_random))
s08_otu_above_cluster <- with(s08_vs_null, sum(OTU > hi_ASV_one_per_cluster))
s08_cluster_gain <- with(s08_vs_null, median_ASV_one_per_cluster - ASV)
# Words that follow the numbers, so that no adjective outlives the data.
s08_count_word <- if (s08_asv_in_random == s08_n_null) {
  "in every pair, so the unit count alone does not move the score"
} else {
  paste0(
    "in ", s08_asv_in_random, " of them: the unit count alone moves the ",
    "score in the others"
  )
}
s08_derived_vs_otu <- s08_paired |>
  group_by(view) |>
  summarise(value = mean(OTU_derived - OTU), .groups = "drop")
# Words that follow the numbers, so that no adjective outlives the data.
s08_share_word <- function(n) {
  if (n == 0) {
    "none"
  } else if (n < s08_n_cols / 2) {
    "a minority"
  } else {
    "a majority"
  }
}
```

Default settings, F1 averaged over the four methods and nine reference
databases; one value per view (`r paste(views$label, collapse = ", ")`).

- **Genus**: the best unit is `r best_phrase(s08_genus_best, "unit")`.
  Column by column (method × database × view, `r s08_n_cols` columns), `OTU`
  beats the ASVs on `r s08_otu_better` (`r s08_share_word(s08_otu_better)`)
  and `OTU_derived` on `r s08_derived_better`
  (`r s08_share_word(s08_derived_better)`). Genus F1 gain over the ASVs,
  per column: `r fmt_range(s08_paired$otu_gain)` for `OTU`,
  `r fmt_range(s08_paired$derived_gain)` for `OTU_derived`.
- **Cluster then assign, or assign then cluster**: `OTU_derived` minus `OTU`,
  mean Genus F1 per view, `r fmt_range(s08_derived_vs_otu$value)`.
- **Species (Gen_sp)**: the best unit is `r best_phrase(s08_gensp_best, "unit")`.
- **ASVs subsampled to the OTU count** (Q5.3, Genus, `r s08_n_null` view ×
  method pairs, 95 % interval of the draws): the full ASV set falls inside the
  interval of the random draws `r s08_count_word`; `OTU` lies above the random draws in
  `r s08_otu_above_random` and above the one-per-cluster draws in
  `r s08_otu_above_cluster`. One ASV per cluster already gains
  `r fmt_range(s08_cluster_gain)` over the full ASV set (median of the
  draws).

```{r summary-fig}
#| echo: false
fig_summary_08_f1_by_unit <- s08_by_unit |>
  ggplot(aes(x = unit, y = value, colour = algo, group = algo)) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  geom_line() +
  facet_grid(tax_level ~ view, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(x = "Unit", y = "F1 (mean over databases)", colour = "Method") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1), legend.position = "bottom")
print(fig_summary_08_f1_by_unit)
save_fig(fig_summary_08_f1_by_unit, "fig_summary_08_f1_by_unit", width = 14, height = 6)
```

Real units scored per unit type (`n_real`, Genus):

```{r n-real}
#| echo: false
res_q5 |>
  filter(metrics == "n_real", tax_level == "Genus") |>
  distinct(view, unit, values) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = unit, values_from = values) |>
  knitr::kable(caption = "Real units scored per view and unit (n_real, Genus).")
```

## Q5.1 — Per-rank × method (F1, MCC)

Mean over the nine databases; bar = min–max over the databases.

```{r q5-1, results = "asis"}
unit_tabs(function(res, v) {
  fig_q5_rank <- res |>
    filter(metrics %in% c("F1_score", "MCC")) |>
    group_by(metrics, tax_level, algo, unit) |>
    summarise(
      value = mean(values),
      lo = min(values),
      hi = max(values),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    ggplot(aes(x = tax_level, y = value, colour = unit, group = unit)) +
    geom_linerange(
      aes(ymin = lo, ymax = hi),
      position = position_dodge(width = 0.5),
      alpha = 0.5
    ) +
    geom_point(position = position_dodge(width = 0.5), size = 2) +
    geom_line(position = position_dodge(width = 0.5)) +
    facet_grid(metrics ~ algo) +
    labs(x = "Rank", y = "Value", colour = "Unit") +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1), legend.position = "bottom")
  print(fig_q5_rank)
  save_fig(fig_q5_rank, paste0("fig_q5_rank_", v$id), width = 14, height = 7)
})
```

## Q5.2 — Per method × database (Genus, Gen_sp)

F1 of each unit, one bar per database; the table gives the Genus F1 of each
OTU unit minus the ASVs.

```{r q5-2, results = "asis"}
unit_tabs(function(res, v) {
  fig_q5_db <- res |>
    filter(metrics == "F1_score", tax_level %in% c("Genus", "Gen_sp")) |>
    mutate(db = factor(db, levels = db_list)) |>
    ggplot(aes(x = db, y = values, fill = unit)) +
    geom_col(position = position_dodge()) +
    facet_grid(tax_level ~ algo) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "F1", fill = "Unit") +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1), legend.position = "bottom")
  print(fig_q5_db)
  save_fig(fig_q5_db, paste0("fig_q5_db_", v$id), width = 14, height = 7)
  res |>
    filter(metrics == "F1_score", tax_level == "Genus") |>
    select(algo, db, unit, values) |>
    pivot_wider(names_from = unit, values_from = values) |>
    mutate(
      `OTU − ASV` = round(OTU - ASV, 3),
      `OTU_derived − ASV` = round(OTU_derived - ASV, 3),
      across(c(ASV, OTU, OTU_derived), \(x) round(x, 3))
    ) |>
    arrange(algo, factor(db, levels = db_list)) |>
    cat_kable(caption = "Genus F1 per unit, and the difference to the ASVs.")
})
```

## Q5.3 — ASVs subsampled to the OTU count

Chapter 01 draws the ASVs 100 times without replacement, on the ASV truth and
the default settings, every control kept: `ASV_random` keeps as many real ASVs
as there are OTU clusters, `ASV_one_per_cluster` one random member of each
cluster. Boxes: Genus and species F1 of each draw, mean over the nine
databases; points: the full ASV set and the two OTU units, averaged the same
way. An OTU point above the `ASV_random` box is not explained by the unit
count; above the `ASV_one_per_cluster` box, not by the cluster structure with
a random representative either.

```{r q5-3}
#| fig-height: 8
fig_q5_subsample <- ggplot() +
  geom_boxplot(
    data = s08_draws,
    aes(x = algo, y = value, fill = unit),
    outlier.size = 0.5,
    alpha = 0.6
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = s08_observed,
    aes(x = algo, y = value, shape = unit),
    size = 2.5,
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.4)
  ) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(ASV = 16, OTU = 17, OTU_derived = 4)) +
  facet_grid(tax_level ~ view, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    x = "Method", y = "F1 (mean over databases)",
    fill = "Subsampled ASVs (100 draws)", shape = "Observed unit"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.box = "vertical")
print(fig_q5_subsample)
save_fig(fig_q5_subsample, "fig_q5_subsample", width = 14, height = 8)
```

```{r q5-3-table}
#| echo: false
s08_vs_null |>
  transmute(
    view,
    algo,
    ASV = round(ASV, 3),
    `ASV_random (95 %)` = paste0(round(lo_ASV_random, 3), "–", round(hi_ASV_random, 3)),
    `one per cluster (95 %)` = paste0(
      round(lo_ASV_one_per_cluster, 3), "–", round(hi_ASV_one_per_cluster, 3)
    ),
    OTU = round(OTU, 3),
    OTU_derived = round(OTU_derived, 3)
  ) |>
  knitr::kable(caption = "Genus F1, mean over the nine databases: the observed units against the 95 % interval of the 100 subsampled ASV draws.")
```
